[[File:Ball of wool detail.png|left|100px]]
A '''ball of wool''' is used in the [[Crafting]] [[skill]]. It is made by using a [[spinning wheel]].

Players looking to obtain large numbers of balls of wool often use [[Neitiznot supplies.]] in [[Neitiznot]] as it has the largest stock of any store with a bank in the same building. After [[Monkey Madness II]], [[Hamab's Crafting Emporium]] on [[Ape Atoll]] is also located close to a bank.

{{Recipe

==Uses==
It can be used on a [[kitten]] for increased attention duration.

===Quests===
*[[Sheep Shearer]]: 20 × balls of wool
*[[Prince Ali Rescue]]: 3 × balls of wool to make a [[wig]]
*[[Regicide]]: 4 × balls of wool to make a [[strip of cloth]]
*[[Monkey Madness I]]: 1 × ball of wool to make a [[M'speak amulet]]
*[[Recipe for Disaster]] ([[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Skrach Uglogwee|Freeing Skrach Uglogwee]] subquest): 1 × ball of wool to make a [[balloon toad]]
*[[Enlightened Journey]]: 1 × ball of wool
